sql:
-- Tabela de parâmetros do simulador de resultado por curso
-- Fonte dos pisos: CCT 2026/2028 SINTEPP-TO (Cláusula 4ª)
-- Salário mensal = hora-aula semanal × 5,25 (Cláusula 5ª)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS vertice_cost_parameters (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  institution_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES vertice_institutions(id),
  
  -- Piso hora-aula por titulação (CCT SINTEPP-TO maio/2026)
  hora_aula_graduado numeric NOT NULL DEFAULT 47.55,
  hora_aula_especialista numeric NOT NULL DEFAULT 52.54,
  hora_aula_mestre numeric NOT NULL DEFAULT 65.11,
  hora_aula_doutor numeric NOT NULL DEFAULT 77.63,
  
  -- Encargos sobre folha (INSS patronal + FGTS + provisões)
  encargos_pct numeric NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.68,  -- 68% sobre salário bruto
  
  -- Ensalamento ideal por modalidade
  ensalamento_ideal_presencial integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 50,
  ensalamento_ideal_semipresencial integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 80,
  ensalamento_ideal_ead integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 120,
  
  -- Overhead operacional (% da receita: infraestrutura, admin, marketing)
  overhead_pct numeric NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.35,  -- 35%
  
  -- Ticket médio mensal por modalidade (estimativa do reitor)
  ticket_presencial numeric NOT NULL DEFAULT 1200.00,
  ticket_semipresencial numeric NOT NULL DEFAULT 800.00,
  ticket_ead numeric NOT NULL DEFAULT 400.00,
  
  -- Meses letivos por semestre
  meses_letivos integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 6,
  
  -- Fator DSR (CLT: 4,5 semanas + 1/6 DSR = 5,25)
  fator_dsr numeric NOT NULL DEFAULT 5.25,
  
  -- Carga horária semanal média por professor (estimativa)
  ch_semanal_media integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 16,
  
  -- Fonte normativa
  fonte_cct text DEFAULT 'CCT 2026/2028 SINTEPP-TO – vigência 01/05/2026 a 30/04/2028',
  
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  
  CONSTRAINT one_per_institution UNIQUE (institution_id)
);

-- Habilitar RLS
ALTER TABLE vertice_cost_parameters ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

-- Política: master e gestor podem ler e editar
CREATE POLICY "cost_params_select" ON vertice_cost_parameters
  FOR SELECT USING (
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM vertice_admins WHERE user_id = auth.uid()
    ) OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM vertice_memberships 
      WHERE user_id = auth.uid() 
      AND institution_id = vertice_cost_parameters.institution_id
      AND role IN ('master','gestor')
    )
  );

CREATE POLICY "cost_params_insert" ON vertice_cost_parameters
  FOR INSERT WITH CHECK (
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM vertice_admins WHERE user_id = auth.uid())
  );

CREATE POLICY "cost_params_update" ON vertice_cost_parameters
  FOR UPDATE USING (
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM vertice_admins WHERE user_id = auth.uid())
    OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM vertice_memberships 
      WHERE user_id = auth.uid() 
      AND institution_id = vertice_cost_parameters.institution_id
      AND role IN ('master','gestor')
    )
  );

-- Inserir parâmetros default para a UNITOP
-- STAGING ONLY: tenant-specific seed omitted; no production institution is copied.

-- Tabela de titulação por professor (para cruzar com custo)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS vertice_professor_titulacao (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  institution_id uuid NOT NULL,
  professor_id integer,
  professor_nome text NOT NULL,
  titulacao text NOT NULL CHECK (titulacao IN ('graduado','especialista','mestre','doutor')),
  regime text DEFAULT 'horista' CHECK (regime IN ('horista','parcial','integral')),
  ch_semanal integer DEFAULT 16,
  cursos_vinculados text[], -- array de nomes de curso
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

ALTER TABLE vertice_professor_titulacao ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

CREATE POLICY "prof_tit_select" ON vertice_professor_titulacao
  FOR SELECT USING (
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM vertice_admins WHERE user_id = auth.uid())
    OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM vertice_memberships 
      WHERE user_id = auth.uid() 
      AND institution_id = vertice_professor_titulacao.institution_id
      AND role IN ('master','gestor')
    )
  );

CREATE POLICY "prof_tit_all" ON vertice_professor_titulacao
  FOR ALL USING (
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM vertice_admins WHERE user_id = auth.uid())
  );
